name: cortex-appsec
description: Shift security left in Claude Code with real-time SAST guardrails and supply chain package risk enrichment powered by Cortex AppSec.

cortex_api_base_url.title: Cortex API base URL
cortex_api_base_url.description: Base URL of your Cortex API gateway, e.g. https://api-<tenant>.xdr.us.paloaltonetworks.com (no trailing slash).

cortex_api_key.title: Cortex API key
cortex_api_key.description: The Cortex API key secret with AppSec permissions. Stored by Claude Code and sent only to your Cortex tenant.

cortex_key_id.title: Cortex API key ID
cortex_key_id.description: The Cortex API key ID associated with your API key.
